extractions.reason: Move the telemetry fold, metrics DTOs and duration formatting used by driver and host into run-metrics. Keep telemetry argument handling and command-only presentation in cmd-telemetry; preserve facade re-exports.
Move flow records, registration and flow-scoped channel operations into flow-session, used by ask, publication and debt readers. Keep flow run CLI execution in cmd-flow.

Move cursor/lease watching and typed frames into watch-lease for run and flow observers; keep CLI stream/log formatting and argument handling in cmd-watch. Move the associated watcher record types with the lease protocol.
Move publication-debt discovery, acknowledgement DTOs and the debt explanation shared with stop-guard into publication-debt. Keep unpublished CLI parsing and exit handling in its command crate.
Move observation-debt classification, wake budget and acknowledgements used by stop-guard into observation-debt. Keep unwatched command argument/session policy in cmd-unwatched.

Move template registry, resolution and plan validation to plan-template, used by launch and all three template subcommands. There is no template-family command crate; command-only list/check/resolve argument handling and rendering stay in their respective command crates.

Move the common branch-publication workflow and supervision protocol used by publish-branch, recover and integrate to branch-publication. Each command owns its verb selection, argument translation and exit handling.

Retained runners re-enter a hidden drive-run route that calls the shared run-control entry point. start/adopt own that runner route without linking another command crate; the published drive-run adapter calls the same implementation.

edgeMoves.reason: plain_on is platform path normalization, not template policy. Move it into processes and forward its old path.
Move result DTOs, outcome constants and pure recorded-hold readers into run-projection. Scheduler and readers use the identical definitions; rendering does not import the reconcile loop.

recordFiles.reason: Move run paths and generic durable JSON/line IO, including their private IO helpers, to run-files. Typed launch/result DTOs remain in run-record. Production writers and phase fixtures call these same IO functions; no producer is mocked and old public paths re-export the identical types/functions.

sharedSlices.reason: Validated run-path lookup is shared by post-launch command adapters.
Grouping is shared presentation vocabulary used by run and goal listings.
Reply and attest share submission receipts, admission and delivery; an attest adapter must not import cmd-reply.
Shutdown/stop share the same process teardown refusal description.
Generic serialization-to-diagnostic conversion is shared by typed renderers; the facade re-exports command items rather than keeping this implementation.

The template parser/renderer and precedence form branch-template; plan-specific Naming and node variables remain with plan-model. Keep identical facade aliases, minijinja semantics and blank-template refusal.

wholeModules.reason: Generic strict YAML parsing/serialization is shared across configuration documents, not part of the plan model. Move cross-document cfg(test) assertions to the existing test-only compatibility/contract suite with every assertion retained.

All watcher registration, holder identity and lease-record logic is shared with flow and debt readers. Move the entire module to watch-lease; CLI-only stdout/log handling remains cmd-watch. Cross-command unit assertions remain in test-only integration coverage.
